name: Futa Quest
source: For some time now, things were going really bad for a young teacher Roxy. All because of her bad reputation. Being a futanari with a strong libido, she liked to take off the sexual tension using her young female students, but one day it all came out sideways when she had sex with the director's daughter. After that, all she could do is pack her things and get away from there before it was too late. But after a while by the greatest piece of good luck, she suddenly got a call from an elite agency and she was offered a specific job.
translation: 一段时间以来，年轻教师罗克西的处境非常糟糕。一切都是因为她的名声不好。作为一名性欲旺盛的扶他，她喜欢用年轻的女学生来缓解性紧张，但有一天，当她与导演的女儿发生性关系时，这一切都出现了问题。之后，她能做的就是收拾东西，趁一切还来得及离开那里。但过了一段时间，幸运的是，她突然接到一家精英机构的电话，并为她提供了一份特定的工作。
